I found three real options. Each is taken from the operator's own page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Swim Basics - Preschool, YMCA of Greater Seattle",
      "age_fit": "ages 3 to 5",
      "when": "Group lessons are 30 minutes, in sessions of six or eight classes. Registration opens seasonally; I did not find winter dates.",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Greater Seattle"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool lessons, Ballard Pool (Seattle Parks and Recreation)",
      "age_fit": "preschool lessons (the page gives no age range for them)",
      "when": "Winter 2027 quarter. Registration opens at 12:00 noon; I did not find the date.",
      "source_name": "Seattle Parks and Recreation"
    },
    {
      "name": "Seattle University Kids Swim Lessons",
      "age_fit": "ages 3+",
      "when": "Winter Quarter Jan 11 to Feb 11 (5 weeks), Monday-Thursday 4:30-5:00pm or 5:00-5:30pm",
      "source_name": "Seattle University Athletics"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Notes on each pick**

- **YMCA of Greater Seattle:**
  - 
The preschool class is for students ages 3 to 5 and covers basic water safety and swimming skills.

  - 
Group lessons are 30 minutes long and packaged by stage in sessions of six or eight classes. Registration opens seasonally.

  - 
Lessons are open to both Y members and community members.

  - The class page showed "this class isn't currently offered" when I read it. That may only reflect no branch being selected, so check your branch before counting on it.
  - I found no price or winter dates.
- **Seattle Parks and Recreation (Ballard Pool):**
  - 
Lessons include parent & child lessons (6 months to 4 years), preschool lessons, youth lessons and private lessons.

  - The page was headed "Winter 2027". I could not read the class days, times or prices.
  - On another city pool's page, 
registration opens at 12:00 noon
. I did not find the winter registration date.
  - 
Families on scholarships may register 1 week early.

- **Seattle University:**
  - 
The page lists Winter Quarter as Monday, Jan. 11 to Thursday, Feb. 11 (5 weeks).

  - 
Lessons are held in the evenings, Monday-Thursday, 4:30-5:00 or 5:00-5:30pm, and are open to ages 3+.

  - 
Sign-up is first come, first served through Sign-up Genius, announced by mailing list about a month before the session.

  - The same page also describes the winter session as Feb/Mar, so confirm the dates with them. I found no price on their page.
